messages:
Emma (oncall): quick morning handoff — tl;dr: P20022 for 429 surge on text-gen-prod between 04:12-04:30 UTC. root cause looks like cache-leader thrash after a coordinator restart + a recently tightened rate-limit rule. impact: ~2.3% 429s, higher p95 latency for ~18m. some retries succeeded. opening notes below.

PagerBot: INCIDENT P20022 opened — 429 surge detected on text-gen-prod, severity: page. affected services: text-generation, routing-proxy. link: https://incidents.internal/r/P20022

Emma (oncall): who got paged: PagerBot -> Raj (primary), Emma (secondary). Raj answered first.

Raj: saw a cluster coordinator restart at 04:09 UTC (k8s node reboot), leader-election on model-cache happened which caused a short window where write ops queued. meanwhile rate-limiter config `global_per_tenant_qps=120` had a stricter enforcement rollout earlier (DeployBot link below) which turned transient queueing into 429s.

Taylor: I rolled the permissive rate-limit back to 300 per-tenant at 04:18 UTC (`deploy rollback rate-limiter --change-id rl-3012`). after rollback 429s dropped to baseline within ~2m. DeployBot logged the rollback.

DeployBot: rolled back rate-limiter config rl-3012 by Taylor at 04:18 UTC. change-id: rl-3012-rollback.

Max: added an autoscaler temporary floor + bumped worker count by +1 for text-gen-pool to help absorb the leader fencing churn. autoscaler floor will stay for 3h unless ops says otherwise. command used: `opsctl scale set text-gen-pool --min 6`.

OpsBot: noticed model-cache leader election events correlated with node kubelet restarts on node-7 and node-11 between 04:07-04:10 UTC. kube events: `eviction: NodeNotReady` on node-11.

Emma (oncall): customer impact assessment: low-medium. Most SDK/HTTP clients retried and resumed. We flagged top 8 tenants (high qps) for SE follow-up. No billing anomalies expected but duplicate retries may show as extra calls in logs.

Zoe: I'm drafting a short incident summary and notifying Customer Success for tenant reach-out. ETA 4h for postmortem draft.

Raj: mitigation notes: 1) rollback rate-limiter -> done. 2) set autoscaler floor + +1 worker -> done. 3) cordon problem nodes for deeper investigation (ops). Also added a temporary leader-election grace period config change `leader_election_backoff=12s` to reduce flip-flop risk; testing patch applied to canary at 04:25.

Emma (oncall): monitoring to watch next 12h: `routing.429_rate`, `cache.leader_changes`, `textgen.p95_latency`. Alert thresholds updated: notify on 5m sustained 429_rate > 0.5%.

Taylor: logs pinned to incident page and I attached the rollback artifact + rate-limiter config diff. Also opened PR to add an integration test to simulate leader-election under load (PR #911).

Max: operations items for next shift: check node health for node-7/11, verify no kernel panic/drivers, follow up with infra team about kubelet restarts. If leader_changes > 3 in 10m, scale pool +2 and escalate to infra oncall.

Emma (oncall): runbook pointer: https://runbooks.internal/textgen/leader-flap (highlights copied below)

```
1) check alerts: `routing.429_rate` & `cache.leader_changes`
2) get current pool size: `kubectl get hpa text-gen-pool -o yaml`
3) if 429s spike -> rollback rate-limiter: `deploy rollback rate-limiter --change-id <id>`
4) if leader flips > 2 -> apply `leader_election_backoff=12s` via configmap and restart coordinator pods
5) scale: `opsctl scale set text-gen-pool --min <n>`
6) if nodes showing kubelet restarts -> cordon/drain and replace, notify infra oncall
```

Emma (oncall): coverage for next shift — primary: Raj, secondary: Taylor, infra escalation: Zoe. shadow: Max (ops). If pager fires, Raj triages; Taylor handles deploys/configs. Escalate to oncall-lead (Zoe) after 20m if unresolved.

Max: ack. I'll bake a small node-health dashboard and add to the incident page.

Zoe: noted on postmortem ownership. I'll coordinate infra follow-up and ensure kernel/drivers are checked.

Emma (oncall): outstanding action items for next shift: [Zoe] finish infra root-cause verification (ETA 6h), [Taylor] merge leader-election integration test (PR #911), [Max] add node-health dashboard, [CS] contact top-8 tenants (Zoe/CS).

Emma (oncall): handoff checklist complete: incident stable, mitigations in place, runbook linked, owners assigned. Leaving thread open 45m for questions then archiving. handing off to Raj as primary. :handshake: 

Raj: taking over as primary. I'll keep autoscaler floor for 3h and monitor leader_changes. ping me for any anomalies. :coffee:
